module: Persistent preferences of the rally recce, saved in rallySettingsRoot/recce.json: last mission id and last load state per level, and the name of the corner call style. Also loads the corner angles file to offer the available styles. The module returns a constructor.
usage:
local RecceSettings = require('/lua/ge/extensions/gameplay/rally/recceSettings')
local s = RecceSettings()
s:load()
s:setLastMissionId('west_coast_usa', 'rally/stage1')
notes: setLastMissionId, setLastLoadState and setCornerCallStyleName save the file immediately.

Potential bug: cornerCallStyleNames and getCornerCallStyle index self.corner_angles_data.pacenoteStyles without checking that corner_angles_data is non-nil (error if loadCornerAngles failed or if load was not called).
The default values are shared by reference (default_settings.last_mission_ids): _reset reuses the same tables, so a modification before a reload can pollute the defaults.

C.desc: Settings object returned by the constructor.

init.desc: Sets the file path (recce.json) and resets to the default values.

_reset.desc: Resets last_mission_ids, last_load_states and corner_call_style_name to the default values.

loadCornerAngles.desc: Loads the corner angle data via rallyUtil.loadCornerAnglesFile; corner_angles_data stays nil on failure.

load.desc: Resets, loads the corner angles then reads recce.json and deserializes it.

returns.desc: false if the path is nil, the file absent or unreadable

save.desc: Writes the serialized settings to recce.json (jsonWriteFile, pretty format).

onSerialize.desc: Returns the table to save (last_mission_ids, last_load_states, corner_call_style_name).

defaultCornerCallStyleName.desc: Name of the first style in the corner angles' pacenoteStyles, or the default value (nil) if there is no data.

cornerCallStyleNames.desc: List of the available corner call style names.

onDeserialized.desc: Applies the data read from the file; missing fields take their default value (style: first available style).

setLastMissionId.desc: Stores the last mission id for a level and saves.

getLastMissionId.desc: Last mission id for a level.

setLastLoadState.desc: Stores the last load state for a level and saves.

state.desc: State to store (inferred from code: free value)

getLastLoadState.desc: Last load state for a level.

setCornerCallStyleName.desc: Sets the corner call style and saves.

getCornerCallStyleName.desc: Name of the current corner call style.

getCornerCallStyle.desc: Returns the style table matching the current name in pacenoteStyles.

returns.desc: Style, or nil if not found
